summary: The diff implements Proxy [[OwnPropertyKeys]] steps 1-23 in order, each with its spec comment above the code. ValidateNonRevokedProxy, GetMethod, Call, CreateListFromArrayLike, the duplicate check, IsExtensible, the target's [[OwnPropertyKeys]] and [[GetOwnProperty]] calls, and the non-configurable and configurable invariant checks all follow the spec's order and use `?` where the spec does. Each TypeError path matches the spec. No test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, no defaults. The remaining 10 failing runs fail on other unimplemented engine functions (Object.getOwnPropertySymbols, Proxy [[GetOwnProperty]], Reflect.ownKeys), which is honest not-implemented behaviour. The only unverified points are the signature and semantics of `ops::create_list_from_array_like`'s boolean argument and whether `key_from_string` canonicalises keys so that HashSet equality is correct. Neither is visible in this diff.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found in this diff. Two things to confirm before merge, both outside the diff: (1) that the boolean passed to ops::create_list_from_array_like(agent, obj, true) selects the ~property-key~ mode, so the spec step 8c check is applied per element; (2) that agent.key_from_string canonicalises array-index strings the same way target keys are canonicalised, so the HashSet duplicate and membership checks in steps 9, 18-22 compare correctly.
